blueprints.name: Starter Cottage Row
blueprints.description: Simple single-room cottages, one per citizen, enough to keep beds claimed.

blueprints.name: Stone Townhouses
blueprints.description: Sturdier multi-room stone houses that improve villager comfort and city defense.

blueprints.name: Guard Watchtower
blueprints.description: A stone tower manned by guards; improves the city's military strength in war.

steps: Build starter_houses immediately so every citizen has a claimed bed.
Upgrade to stone_townhouses once stone production allows it without starving the farm project.
Consider a watchtower before declaring or expecting war.
